briefing: - MiCollab命令注入已在野利用且有POC，应立即修复。
- 同产品另两个KEV漏洞同版本受影响，建议整体升级。
- Danfoss AK-SM 800A两条8.8分KEV漏洞，工控侧尽快处置。
- Jenkins批量公告三个RCE/越权漏洞，最高9.9，需排查CI暴露面。
- 本批未见勒索软件关联；优先处置KEV及9分以上RCE，跟踪Drupal公告。

items.title: MiCollab AWV未认证命令注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可经AWV组件注入系统命令，以服务进程权限执行任意命令。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本，限制AWV接口公网暴露并审计异常命令
items.repro_note: AWV组件未认证入口，构造恶意参数触发命令注入
items.impact_scope: 统一通信/会议系统，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864.

items.title: MiCollab AWV未认证认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可利用认证处理缺陷绕过登录，在应用内执行未授权操作。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本，限制AWV公网访问并审计异常访问
items.repro_note: 未认证访问AWV认证入口，构造请求绕过认证
items.impact_scope: 统一通信/会议系统，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an authentication bypass attack due to improper handling of authentication. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and perform unauthorized actions within the context of the application. This is MTLVULN-1877.

items.title: AK-SM 800A认证后路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者可经XML接口读取底层系统文件，可能导致整机失陷。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件，限制XML接口访问权限
items.repro_note: 登录后经XML接口传路径参数读取系统文件
items.impact_scope: 制冷控制器/边缘设备，可能暴露内网
items.description: Due to improper restriction, authenticated attackers could retrieve and read system files of the underlying server through the XML interface. The information that can be read can lead to a full system compromise.

items.title: MiCollab AWV未认证任意文件上传
items.title_zh: MiCollab AWV未认证任意文件上传
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可经AWV上传任意类型文件，可能植入恶意内容并扩大影响。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本，限制AWV上传接口公网访问
items.repro_note: AWV未认证上传入口，绕过文件类型校验投递文件
items.impact_scope: 统一通信/会议系统，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an arbitrary file upload attack due to insufficient file type validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary files to the target system. This is MTLVULN-1861.

items.title: MiCollab AWV未认证XML注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可借助预置恶意内容触发XML注入，进而在系统上下文执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，限制AWV接口并校验XML输入
items.repro_note: 需预置恶意内容，经AWV XML入口注入命令
items.impact_scope: 统一通信/会议系统，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1862.

items.title: MiCollab AWV凭据保护不足
items.summary_zh: 知晓特定随机标识或预置内容的未认证攻击者可绕过认证访问系统。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，限制AWV接口并轮换相关凭据
items.repro_note: 需已知系统随机标识/预置内容，经AWV认证入口越权
items.impact_scope: 统一通信/会议系统，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker, with knowledge of a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information.

items.title: AK-SM 800A认证后命令注入
items.summary_zh: 已认证远程攻击者可利用输入校验缺失，在目标系统执行任意命令。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件，限制管理接口访问
items.repro_note: 登录管理端，经未校验输入参数注入系统命令
items.impact_scope: 制冷控制器/边缘设备，可能暴露内网
items.description: Due to improper input validation, an authenticated remote attacker could execute arbitrary commands on the target system.

items.title: Jenkins Script Security沙箱绕过RCE
items.summary_zh: 具脚本定义/运行权限者可借@Builder部分限定名绕过沙箱，在控制器执行代码。
items.affected: Jenkins(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Script Security插件至修复版本并审计流水线权限
items.repro_note: 需脚本/Pipeline权限，用部分限定@Builder加载任意类
items.impact_scope: CI控制器，凭据与构建链高价值
items.description: Jenkins Script Security Plugin 1436.v1082791135e4 and earlier does not reject @Builder annotations whose builderStrategy member names an arbitrary class when the annotation is referred to using a partially qualified class name, allowing attackers with permission to define and run sandboxed scripts, including Pipelines, to execute code outside the sandbox if a suitable class is present on the classpath of the component that evaluates the script.

items.title: Jenkins Warnings插件内联Groovy RCE
items.summary_zh: 可定义内联Groovy解析器的攻击者可在控制器JVM无沙箱执行任意代码。
items.affected: Jenkins(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Warnings插件至修复版本，限制流水线定义权限
items.repro_note: 需权限定义内联Groovy解析器，脚本在控制器编译执行
items.impact_scope: CI控制器，构建链与凭据风险
items.description: Jenkins Warnings Plugin 13.10251.va_452d3553728 through 13.10365.v85cd7a_c8110b_ (both inclusive) allows defining inline Groovy parsers whose Groovy scripts are compiled on the Jenkins controller without sandbox protection, allowing attackers able to define inline Groovy parsers to execute arbitrary code in the context of the Jenkins controller JVM.

items.title: Jenkins Pipeline Groovy沙箱绕过
items.summary_zh: 具沙箱Pipeline定义/运行权限者可经接口字段初始化器绕过沙箱执行代码。
items.affected: Jenkins(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Pipeline Groovy插件至修复版本，收敛脚本权限
items.repro_note: 需Pipeline权限，构造接口字段初始化器逃逸沙箱
items.impact_scope: CI控制器，构建链与凭据风险
items.description: Sandbox protection in Jenkins Pipeline: Groovy Plugin 4403.v471713a_cea_19 and earlier can be circumvented through interface field initializers, allowing attackers with permission to define and run sandboxed Pipelines to bypass the sandbox protection and execute arbitrary code in the context of the Jenkins controller JVM.

items.title: 容器网关路径混淆认证绕过
items.title_zh: 容器网关路径混淆认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造请求路径绕过nginx认证，经网关访问Things/Policies API并下发设备消息。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 应用网关修复，审查nginx路由并统一鉴权
items.repro_note: 构造含特殊路径请求，使nginx路由到未认证location
items.impact_scope: API网关/设备管理面，可控制设备
items.description: A crafted request path is therefore routed by nginx through such an unauthenticated location and by the gateway to the regular Things and Policies HTTP API, including routes that send live messages to devices. When pre-authentication is enabled (the default of the Helm chart and the Docker Compose setup), an unauthenticated remote attacker can impersonate arbitrary policy subjects and read, modify and delete Things, read Policies, send messages to devices and create entities.

items.title: Jenkins Gradle插件XXE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可经构建工作区Maven扩展配置触发XXE，读取文件或发起请求。
items.affected: Jenkins(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Gradle插件至修复版本，禁用外部实体
items.repro_note: 构建工作区放置恶意Maven扩展XML，触发XXE解析
items.impact_scope: CI控制器，构建环境文件读取
items.description: Jenkins Gradle Plugin 2.21.1282.v024680ce00a_b_ and earlier does not configure its XML parser to prevent XML external entity (XXE) attacks when processing Maven extension configuration files from build workspaces.

items.title: Azure Cassandra命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 相邻网络未授权攻击者可利用命令注入在Azure Cassandra实例执行代码。
items.action_zh: 跟进Azure平台修复，限制相邻网络访问并审计实例
items.repro_note: 从相邻网络向受影响服务接口注入OS命令
items.impact_scope: 云数据库托管实例，数据与租户隔离风险
items.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an os command ('os command injection') in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over an adjacent network.

items.title: MediaFocusFidl竞态UAF远程RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用MediaFocusFidlImpl竞态UAF，无需交互执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 应用厂商补丁，限制媒体焦点服务暴露并启用缓解
items.repro_note: 竞态触发MediaFocusFidlImpl UAF，无需用户交互
items.impact_scope: 媒体服务组件，远程无交互攻击面
items.description: In MediaFocusFidlImpl of media_focus_fidl_impl.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: openIMIS报表代理越权访问
items.summary_zh: 任意已登录用户可经OpenSearch报表代理越权使用硬编码管理员凭据，访问敏感数据。
items.action_zh: 升级openIMIS，启用OpenSearch安全插件并移除硬编码凭据
items.repro_note: 登录后访问OpenSearch报表代理，越权使用内置管理员凭据
items.impact_scope: 医保业务系统，报表与搜索数据暴露
items.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting.

items.title: Symfony Filesystem路径遍历写入
items.summary_zh: 恶意或被篡改的依赖包可借Path::split路径解析，使importmap命令越界写入文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级Symfony Filesystem修复版本并审查依赖来源
items.repro_note: 引入恶意包，经importmap:require/install触发越界写入
items.impact_scope: PHP项目构建链，供应链文件写入
items.description: Most methods of Symfony\Component\Filesystem\Path rely on Path::split(), which takes everything before the first :// as the root of a path. A malicious or compromised package can therefore make importmap:require or importmap:install write a file of its choice outside assets/vendor.

items.title: Drupal Content Synchronizer反序列
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可借不可信数据反序列化触发对象注入，可能造成代码执行或数据篡改。
items.affected: Drupal(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Content Synchronizer修复版本或临时禁用模块
items.impact_scope: Drupal站点内容同步，模块面风险
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Drupal Content Synchronizer allows Object Injection. This issue affects Content Synchronizer versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.1.

items.title: Drupal Real Name模板注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可经受影响模板字段注入代码，可能执行任意代码或篡改页面。
items.affected: Drupal(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级Real Name修复版本或临时禁用该模块
items.impact_scope: Drupal站点用户展示，模块面风险
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability in Drupal Real Name allows Code Injection. This issue affects Real Name versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.1.

items.title: Apache Texera PVE接口未认证
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可访问计算单元PVE管理接口，可能操控虚拟环境并扩大影响。
items.action_zh: 升级Apache Texera修复版本，限制PVE管理接口访问
items.repro_note: 直接访问计算单元PVE管理端点，无需认证
items.impact_scope: 计算单元虚拟环境，可能横向控制
items.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in Apache Texera (incubating). The Python virtual environment (PVE) management endpoints of a computing unit are not authenticated by the application itself.

items.title: PHPGurukul请假系统 密码找回绕过
items.title_zh: PHPGurukul请假系统 密码找回绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者凭有效员工ID与邮箱即可进入改密流程，无需带外验证，可接管账户。
items.action_zh: 限制密码找回入口并增加带外校验，联系厂商获取修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权访问forgot-password.php；需员工ID及邮箱；进入改密
items.impact_scope: 企业内网HR系统，账户接管风险
items.description: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System v2.1 contains an insufficient verification vulnerability in the password recovery functionality in forgot-password.php. The application allows an unauthenticated user to access the password-change workflow by providing a valid employee ID and corresponding email address without requiring an additional out-of-band verification mechanism.

items.title: Apache Texera 删除接口未授权
items.title_zh: Apache Texera 删除接口未授权
items.summary_zh: 能访问Texera实例的攻击者可未授权调用删除接口，删除任意工作流执行结果。
items.action_zh: 升级到 1.3.0-incubating 修复
items.repro_note: 未授权调用工作流执行结果删除API；无需认证；定位删除接口
items.impact_scope: 工作流平台，未授权删除数据
items.description: An API which can allow a user to delete any workflow execution results is missing authentication. This means that any workflow result could be deleted by someone able to reach the Texera instance. This issue affects Apache Texera: from 1.1.0-incubating before 1.3.0-incubating. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.3.0-incubating, which fixes the issue.

items.title: Sig 未授权 CWE-470
items.description: XML::Sig versions before 0.74 for Perl allow code execution via a document's Algorithm attribute that verify resolves to a function name and calls. An attacker who can submit a signed document can run a command as the verifying process.

items.title: PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management 未授权 信息泄露
items.description: An issue in PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System (ELMS) Version 2.1 allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges via the password recovery functionality

items.title: User 未授权 释放后重用(UAF)
items.description: In LogicalLink::SignalError of logical_link.cc, there is a possible use after free due to an error callback that can synchronously destroy the link while its channels are still being iterated. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: User 未授权 释放后重用(UAF)
items.description: In HandleRxPdu of channel.cc, there is a possible use after free due to the channel being destroyed while it is still processing a received frame. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: HostURLFilter.configure 未授权 CWE-1025
items.description: Description `HostURLFilter.configure` reads the `ignoreOutsideDomain` parameter but tests the node belonging to `ignoreOutsideHost` when deciding whether the domain mode was configured. A filter configuration that names only `ignoreOutsideDomain`, which the class documentation presents as an independent mode, is therefore discarded: the flag is forced to false, `filter` short-circuits on its guard and every URL is returned unchanged.

items.title: Apache JSPWiki 会话固定劫持
items.title_zh: Apache JSPWiki 会话固定劫持
items.summary_zh: 攻击者预设会话ID并诱导受害者登录，随后复用同一ID劫持其已认证会话。
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；登录后强制更换会话标识并校验来源
items.repro_note: 登录前固定JSESSIONID；诱导受害者携带该会话登录后复用
items.impact_scope: Wiki协作平台，账户会话劫持
items.description: Session Fixation in the login flow of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. The session identifier was not replaced when a user authenticated, so an attacker who could set a known session identifier in the browser of a victim could use the same identifier after the victim logged in. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 (3.x) or 2.12.6 (2.x), which fix this issue.

items.title: Drupal WordsOnline连接器SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可经WordsOnline Connector未净化参数实施SQL注入，读取或篡改数据库。
items.affected: Drupal(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级WordsOnline Connector修复版本或临时禁用模块
items.impact_scope: Drupal站点数据库，模块面风险
items.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Drupal WordsOnline Connector allows SQL Injection. This issue affects WordsOnline Connector versions: from 2.0.0 to 2.0.6.

items.title: Pathname 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in WP Media WP Rocket wp-rocket allows Path Traversal.This issue affects WP Rocket: from n/a before 3.24.2.

items.title: Successful 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted input through the affected API endpoint to the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially resulting in unauthorized disclosure, modification or deletion of database information on the targeted system.

items.title: Directory 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Directory traversal vulnerability in the custom-homepage asset endpoint (/__api__/custom/home/) allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files readable by the Package Manager service account via a filesystem path appended to the request URI in Posit Software, PBC Posit Package Manager: * before 2025.09.6, * 2025.12.x before 2025.12.4 * 2026.04.x before 2026.04.4 * 2026.05.x before 2026.05.2 * 2026.06.x before 2026.06.2 * 2026.08.x before 2026.08.2 * 2026.09.x before 2026.09.2 * 2026.10.x before…

items.title: D-Link R32 flupl接口命令注入
items.title_zh: D-Link R32 flupl接口命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵flupl端点fpath参数注入系统命令，在路由器httpd权限下执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；关闭公网管理并限制接口访问
items.repro_note: 访问flupl self端点，向fpath参数注入命令；需可访问httpd
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，可能暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. This affects an unknown function of the file /usr/bin/httpd of the component flupl self Endpoint. Performing a manipulation of the argument fpath results in os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: Such 未授权 CWE-285
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK N350RT 9.3.5u.6468_B20250827/9.3.5u.6466_B20250825. The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: D-Link R32 时间设置命令注入
items.title_zh: D-Link R32 时间设置命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵DHMAPI SetTimeSettings的TZLocation参数注入系统命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；关闭公网管理并限制接口访问
items.repro_note: SetTimeSettings的TZLocation参数注入；需访问管理接口
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，可能暴露公网
items.description: A flaw has been found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. The affected element is the function SetTimeSettings of the component DHMAPI Action Handler. This manipulation of the argument TZLocation causes os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: D-Link R32 设备设置命令注入
items.title_zh: D-Link R32 设备设置命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵DHMAPI SetDeviceSettings的TZLocation参数注入系统命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复固件；关闭公网管理并限制接口访问
items.repro_note: SetDeviceSettings的TZLocation参数注入；需访问管理接口
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，可能暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. The impacted element is the function SetDeviceSettings of the file /usr/bin/httpd of the component DHMAPI Action Handler. Such manipulation of the argument TZLocation leads to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

items.title: 未知Python应用 表达式注入RCE
items.title_zh: 未知Python应用 表达式注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可构造恶意表达式经datetime.sys触达os执行命令，并用key参数读取任意文件窃取密钥。
items.action_zh: 限制表达式与key参数入口，升级修复版本；最小化运行权限
items.repro_note: 表达式求值入口；构造datetime.sys到os链；key参数可读文件
items.impact_scope: Python Web应用，主机与密钥泄露
items.description: An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JWT signing keys.

items.title: safe_eval 沙箱绕过代码执行
items.title_zh: safe_eval 沙箱绕过代码执行
items.summary_zh: 控制safe_eval表达式的攻击者可借间接下标调用绕过AST校验，执行任意Python代码。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；禁止不可信输入进入safe_eval
items.repro_note: 构造间接下标调用builtins.exec的表达式传入safe_eval
items.impact_scope: Python应用沙箱，代码执行风险
items.description: From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() function can be bypassed with indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation blocks only direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker who controls an expression passed to safe_eval() can execute arbitrary Python code with the permissions of the host application.

items.title: build-git-clone 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者向clone()传入含;或$()的仓库URL，经sh -c拼接执行系统命令，控制Node.js进程。
items.action_zh: 升级到1.0.4；对仓库URL做白名单和转义
items.repro_note: 调用clone()传入含;或$()的url；拼接进sh -c触发命令注入
items.impact_scope: 构建系统/Node.js服务，命令执行
items.description: build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

items.title: ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig is vulnerable to remote command injection via HTTP request. Due to the lack of input sanitization, a privileged attacker can inject shell metacharacters in the server parameter, resulting in arbitrary command execution as the root user on the operating system. This issue was fixed in version 1.5.14.

items.title: SeaweedFS 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Because password authentication is enabled by default, a remote attacker who knows a valid username can log in without a key or secret and obtain an SFTP session with that user's home directory and path permissions.

items.description: ### Impact If attacker have access to admin user, it is possible to abuse this vulnerability to gain access into the system.

items.title: 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.

items.title: Kiro Web 未授权 命令注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)

items.title: KubeSphere 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check.

items.title: ChargePoint Home Flex EV 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of root.

items.title: Grav Form 代码注入(RCE)

Attackers can upload .txt or .svg files containing Twig and have them rendered as trusted templates outside the sandbox, executing code as the web server user.

items.title: Elasticsearch 未授权 反序列化(RCE)

items.description: Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combined with a gadget chain like the bundled Commons Collections 3.1-RC1 library can lead to code execution as the Camunda service account.

items.title: @waline/client XSS
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: ### Summary `@waline/client` renders the comment editor's live preview with `marked` and no sanitizer (`utils/markdown.ts`), and the preview is injected with `v-html`. So an administrator who clicks Edit on an attacker's comment renders that attacker's raw HTML in their own session: an unauthenticated commenter achieves privilege-escalation stored XSS against a moderator with a single Edit click.

It treated a client encoding named by an alias the server accepts, such as WIN950, Windows950 or big-5 for BIG5, as single-byte, and it accepted too narrow a range of lead bytes for JOHAB, EUC_TW, EUC_CN and EUC_KR.

items.description: In deployments where a trusted intermediary does not overwrite these headers, or where the firewall permits direct API access, varying the applicable header on repeated POST /auth/login requests gives an unauthenticated remote attacker a distinct throttle bucket for each attempt, so the five-attempts-per-60-seconds limit does not trigger and no account lockout, CAPTCHA, or exponential backoff limits password guessing.
